ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) features occupying approximately 10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation with localized high-contrast clusters: dense white cluster at the right distal tip (coordinate range: far right, upper edge); scattered punctate white spots and linear marks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle (~140 degrees) and a shallow depth/height ratio of ~0.08.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity; characterized by three distinct deep notches on the left lobe trailing edge and smaller, jagged serrations along the entire right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature sweeping upward and outward to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of circular white pixel groups on the right fluke tip; smaller isolated circular marks scattered across the medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the left lobe and upper right lobe near the margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged tissue excisions on the medial section of the left lobe trailing edge; heavy scarring and possible barnacle remnants at the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'saw-tooth' profile on the inner half of the left lobe trailing edge consisting of multiple deep, non-uniform indentations.
